song.title: The Man Who Can't Be Moved

guitar.evidence: Mark Sheehan was The Script's guitarist; no specific iconic model widely documented.

tone.target: bright jangly pop-rock clean with chorus and delay
tone.profile: bright jangly pop-rock clean with chorus and delay
tone.summary: A jangly pop-rock chain featuring a light boost for clarity, Chorus for subtle movement, and a clean AC30/Silver Twin emulation with Plate reverb and Digital Delay for sparkle.
corrections: drop crunch as a main feature
make it more jangly than atmospheric
